o2_fraction.label: Oxygen
o2_fraction.description: Oxygen mole fraction of the oxidizer. For most tests this is the ambient atmosphere in the chamber; for inverse flames it is the oxidizer stream fed through the burner (see o2_basis).

o2_basis.label: Oxygen refers to
o2_basis.description: "ambient" when oxygen describes the atmosphere surrounding the fuel; "oxidizer stream" when oxygen is injected into a fuel atmosphere (inverse flames).

pressure_kpa.label: Pressure
pressure_kpa.description: Total pressure of the test atmosphere.

n2_fraction.label: Nitrogen
n2_fraction.description: Nitrogen mole fraction of the ambient atmosphere.

co2_fraction.label: Carbon dioxide
co2_fraction.description: Carbon dioxide mole fraction of the ambient atmosphere (a suppressant in FLEX).

he_fraction.label: Helium
he_fraction.description: Helium mole fraction of the ambient atmosphere.

diluent.label: Diluent
diluent.description: Inert gas or gases making up the balance of the atmosphere.

flow_speed_cm_s.label: Flow speed
flow_speed_cm_s.description: Speed of the forced gas flow past the fuel.

flow_direction.label: Flow direction
flow_direction.description: Direction of the forced flow relative to flame spread: concurrent or opposed.

ambient_temperature_c.label: Ambient temperature
ambient_temperature_c.description: Initial temperature of the test atmosphere.

fuel_fraction.label: Fuel fraction
fuel_fraction.description: Mole (volume) fraction of fuel in the fuel stream; the rest is inert diluent.

fuel_diluent.label: Fuel diluent
fuel_diluent.description: Inert gas mixed into the fuel stream.

oxidizer_flow_mg_s.label: Oxidizer flow rate
oxidizer_flow_mg_s.description: Mass flow rate of oxygen through the burner (inverse flames).

geometry.label: Geometry
geometry.description: Shape of the fuel sample or burner.

size_mm.label: Characteristic size
size_mm.description: Droplet, burner, nozzle, rod or sphere diameter.

igniter_power_w.label: Igniter power
igniter_power_w.description: Electrical power applied to the igniter.

ignition_time_s.label: Ignition time
ignition_time_s.description: How long the igniter was powered.

ignited.label: Ignited
ignited.description: Whether a hot flame was established.

flames_ignited.label: Flames ignited
flames_ignited.description: Number of flames ignited in a test session (session-level tables).

end_mode.label: How the test ended
end_mode.description: Self-extinguished, flow terminated, extinction, disruption or burned to completion.

burning_rate_mm2_s.label: Burning-rate constant
burning_rate_mm2_s.description: Droplet burning-rate constant. The PSI column header reads "Burning rate; mm"; droplet burning-rate constants are conventionally reported in mm²/s and the values are in that range.

extinction_diameter_mm.label: Extinction diameter
extinction_diameter_mm.description: Droplet diameter at which the visible flame went out.

spread_rate_mm_s.label: Flame spread rate
spread_rate_mm_s.description: Speed at which the flame moved along a solid sample in microgravity.

burn_length_cm.label: Burn length
burn_length_cm.description: Length of a solid sample consumed in microgravity.

spread_rate_1g_mm_s.label: Flame spread rate at 1 g
spread_rate_1g_mm_s.description: Spread rate of the same material in the normal-gravity comparison test.

burn_length_1g_cm.label: Burn length at 1 g
burn_length_1g_cm.description: Burn length of the same material in the normal-gravity comparison test.

cool_flame.label: Cool flame observed
cool_flame.description: Whether a low-temperature "cool" flame was observed.

flame_color.label: Flame colour
flame_color.description: Visible colour of the flame as logged by the science team.

o2_fraction_final.label: Oxygen at end of test
o2_fraction_final.description: Oxygen mole fraction measured after the test.

co2_fraction_final.label: Carbon dioxide at end of test
co2_fraction_final.description: Carbon dioxide mole fraction measured after the test.

co_ppm_final.label: Carbon monoxide at end of test
co_ppm_final.description: Carbon monoxide concentration measured after the test.

adiabatic_flame_temp_k.label: Adiabatic flame temperature
adiabatic_flame_temp_k.description: Calculated adiabatic flame temperature for the test's reactants.

stoich_mixture_fraction.label: Stoichiometric mixture fraction
stoich_mixture_fraction.description: Zst - where the flame sits between the fuel and oxidizer sides.

heater_ratio.label: Heater resistance ratio
heater_ratio.description: Rt/R0, the heater wire's resistance relative to room temperature - a proxy for sample heating temperature in the smoke experiments.

heating_time_s.label: Heating time
heating_time_s.description: How long the sample was heated to generate smoke.

aging_time_s.label: Smoke aging time
aging_time_s.description: Time the smoke was held before measurement.

mass_loss_rate_mg_min.label: Mass loss rate
mass_loss_rate_mg_min.description: Rate at which the heated sample lost mass.

flame_type.label: Flame type
flame_type.description: normal (fuel flows into oxidizer) or inverse (oxidizer flows into fuel).

field_polarity.label: Electric-field polarity
field_polarity.description: Polarity of the high-voltage mesh electrode relative to the burner.

test_date.label: Test date
test_date.description: Date of the test or session (ISO format).

investigator.label: Investigator
investigator.description: Principal investigator whose test matrix the run belongs to.

description.label: Description
description.description: Free-text description from the PSI table.

notes.label: Notes
notes.description: Operator comments from the PSI table.

acme_pmt1_gain.label: Photomultiplier tube 1 gain setting
acme_pmt1_gain.description: NASA's definition: "PMT1_GAIN PMT1 Gain 4.63 to 10 V For recommended device control voltage of 0.5 to 1.1 V. Gain range is 5x103 to 3.5x106. Gain=2x106 * (Output voltage/9.2645)^8.643856. Or Output voltage = 10^(0.115689 * log(Gain) + 0.23786213). Device is Hamamatsu H10722-10-MOD2." (PSI-20_Science Documents_ACME_non-imaging_data_file_description.pdf).

acme_pmt3_gain.label: Photomultiplier tube 3 gain setting
acme_pmt3_gain.description: NASA's definition: "PMT3_GAIN PMT3 Gain 4.63 to 10 For recommended device control voltage of 0.5 to 1.1 V. Gain range is 5x103 to 3.5x106. Gain=2x106 * (Output voltage/9.2645)^8.643856. Or Output voltage = 10^(0.115689 * log(Gain) + 0.23786213). Device is Hamamatsu H10722-10-MOD2." (PSI-20_Science Documents_ACME_non-imaging_data_file_description.pdf).

acme_pmt_oh_ua.label: Photomultiplier tube current, OH* (310 nm band)
acme_pmt_oh_ua.description: NASA's definition: "[S2, p. 5] 0 to 4 µA. Current (µA) = Voltage * 1. Depends on PMT1_GAIN, Table 3. Device is Hamamatsu H10722-10- MOD2. Looks through a 310 nm bandpass interference filter [S3, p. 11] but one will have a 310-nm bandpass filter and another will have a 430-nm bandpass filter (where both are with a 10-nm FWHM). The pair of detectors will enable measurement of OH* and CH* emission, respectively." (PSI-20_Science Documents_ACME_non-imaging_data_file_description.pdf).

acme_pmt_ch_ua.label: Photomultiplier tube current, CH* (430 nm band)
acme_pmt_ch_ua.description: NASA's definition: "[S2, p. 6] 0 to 4 µA. Current (µA) = Voltage * 1. Depends on PMT3_GAIN, Table 3. Device is Hamamatsu H10722-10- MOD2. Looks through a 430 nm bandpass interference filter [S3, p. 11] but one will have a 310-nm bandpass filter and another will have a 430-nm bandpass filter (where both are with a 10-nm FWHM). The pair of detectors will enable measurement of OH* and CH* emission, respectively." (PSI-20_Science Documents_ACME_non-imaging_data_file_description.pdf).

saffire_anemometer_1_cm_s.description: NASA's definition: "Anemometer 1; cm/sec" (PSI-100_Raw Data_Saffire III Sample 1 Sensors.xlsx).

saffire_humidity_pct.description: NASA's definition: "Humidity; %" (PSI-100_Raw Data_Saffire III Sample 1 Sensors.xlsx).

saffire_inlet_temp_c.description: NASA's definition: "Test Section Inlet Temp; Degrees C" (PSI-100_Raw Data_Saffire III Sample 1 Sensors.xlsx).

saffire_plume_temp_tc5_c.description: NASA's definition: "Plume Temp 5 (TC5); Degrees C" (PSI-100_Raw Data_Saffire III Sample 1 Sensors.xlsx).

saffire_plume_temp_tc6_c.description: NASA's definition: "Plume Temp 6 (TC6); Degrees C" (PSI-100_Raw Data_Saffire III Sample 1 Sensors.xlsx).

saffire_sample_temp_tc7_c.label: Saffire sample temperature, thermocouple TC7
saffire_sample_temp_tc7_c.description: NASA's definition: "Sample Temp 1 (TC7); Degrees C" (PSI-100_Raw Data_Saffire III Sample 1 Sensors.xlsx).

saffire_sample_temp_tc8_c.label: Saffire sample temperature, thermocouple TC8
saffire_sample_temp_tc8_c.description: NASA's definition: "Sample Temp 2 (TC8); Degrees C" (PSI-100_Raw Data_Saffire III Sample 1 Sensors.xlsx).

saffire_sample_temp_tc9_c.description: NASA's definition: "Sample Temp 3 (TC9); Degrees C" (PSI-100_Raw Data_Saffire III Sample 1 Sensors.xlsx).

saffire_sample_temp_tc10_c.description: NASA's definition: "Sample Temp 4 (TC10); Degrees C" (PSI-100_Raw Data_Saffire III Sample 1 Sensors.xlsx).

saffire_sample_temp_tc12_c.description: NASA's definition: "Sample Temp 6 (TC12); Degrees C" (PSI-100_Raw Data_Saffire III Sample 1 Sensors.xlsx).

smoke_diameter_average_mass_um.label: Smoke diameter of average mass
smoke_diameter_average_mass_um.description: NASA's definition: "Diameter of Average Mass (M3/M0)1/3 (µm)" (PSI-101_Reports_SAME-R_Final Report.pdf).

ptrak_count_thousand_per_cm3.label: P-Trak particle count reading, thousands per cm3 (as logged, before NASA's dilution and calibration)

dusttrak_b_mass_mg_per_m3.label: DustTrak B smoke mass concentration reading (as logged, before NASA's dilution and calibration)

smoke_point_length_mm.label: Smoke point length
smoke_point_length_mm.description: NASA's definition: "The smoke point lengths, LSP, (and the flow conditions) were obtained from the video record and are the measured distance from the burner to the tip of the luminous flame on the flame axis." (PSI-107_Reports_SPICE_FinalReport.pdf).

flame_length_mm.label: Flame length (Data II column Length)
flame_length_mm.description: NASA's files give no definition for this reading. It is kept as logged.

flame_width_max_mm.label: Maximum flame width
flame_width_max_mm.description: NASA's files give no definition for this reading. It is kept as logged.

flame_height_nikon_mm.label: Flame height from the Nikon still
flame_height_nikon_mm.description: NASA's files give no definition for this reading. It is kept as logged.

bass_fan_display.label: Fan display on the video (fan voltage x10)
bass_fan_display.description: NASA's definition: "Fan display: instantaneous fan voltagex10 on the video display. Maximum was 122, or 12.2 volts." (PSI-25_Science Documents_BASS-II_ReadMe.docx).

bass_radiometer_display.label: Radiometer on the video (uncalibrated, relative)
bass_radiometer_display.description: NASA's definition: "Radiometer gain: Uncalibrated radiometer gain, radiometer is displayed on the video. Adjusted to avoid saturation. Useful for relative flame intensity readings and flame dynamics (like pre-extinction oscillations). Video display data rate is 5 Hz." (PSI-25_Science Documents_BASS-II_ReadMe.docx).

burning_rate_cool_mm2_s.label: Cool-flame burning-rate constant
burning_rate_cool_mm2_s.description: NASA's files give no definition for this reading. It is kept as logged.

extinction_diameter_cool_mm.label: Cool-flame extinction diameter
extinction_diameter_cool_mm.description: NASA's files give no definition for this reading. It is kept as logged.

particle_number_conc_cm3.label: Particle number concentration (P-Trak)
particle_number_conc_cm3.description: NASA's definition: "The P-Trak gives a number count of the particles in an aerosol, in readings of particles/cm3." (PSI-47_Reports_DAFT_FinalReport.doc).

particle_mass_conc_mg_m3.label: Particle mass concentration (DustTrak)
particle_mass_conc_mg_m3.description: NASA's definition: "DustTrak gives measurements of the total mass, in mg/m3." (PSI-47_Reports_DAFT_FinalReport.doc).

mass_per_particle_g.label: Mass per particle (DustTrak mass over P-Trak count)
mass_per_particle_g.description: NASA's definition: "Mass Per Particle (gram)" (PSI-47_Analyzed Data_DAFT Retrieved Data Summary.xls).

particle_diameter_mass_um.label: Particle diameter from the mass per particle (assumed density)
particle_diameter_mass_um.description: NASA's definition: "Particle Diameter (micon)" (PSI-47_Analyzed Data_ISS_Daft_Aug21_0611zgy time hist.xls).

dust_fill_toggles.label: Fill-valve toggles used to put dust into the sample bag
dust_fill_toggles.description: NASA's definition: "Six toggles were used to introduce dust into Sample Bag #2." (PSI-47_Reports_DAFT_FinalReport.doc).

flame_diameter_oh_mm.label: Flame diameter, OH camera (LLUV)
flame_diameter_oh_mm.description: NASA's definition: "LLUV flame size as a function of time" (NTRS-20150023456.pdf).
